method: Original unquantized watch-size RGBA -> no-dither imagequant 96/80 colors -> indexed PNG; unchanged portrait geometry. Opaque title/menu backgrounds -> non-progressive JPEG 98/95, 4:4:4.
note: Palette quantization and JPEG are lossy. The source-relative MSE checks are conservative objective checks, not a guarantee of identical perception or pixels. All unchanged CG/backgrounds and portrait files retain their original bytes.
